title: Project workspace task list — Tasklane
notes: v1 is a dark-sidebar workspace with a <table> task list (one <tbody> per section, native checkboxes). v2 is a Tailwind rewrite: the list becomes an ARIA treegrid of div rows, sections are reordered (Development first) and tasks sorted by due date, completion checkboxes become button[role=checkbox], due dates read 'Thu, Nov 12'. The sidebar gains a Favorites section and an alphabetical Projects list (a hidden mobile drawer repeats it). Project tabs become role=tab buttons with new 'Dashboard'/'Messages' tabs. The assignee filter keeps its id but loses the wrapping label. Member avatars and the activity panel become web components with declarative shadow roots.
